evidence: Has the Validation label and directly modifies validation.cpp to hash the UTXO set and check AssumeUTXO commitments during IBD.
rationale: The change adds automated verification of hardcoded AssumeUTXO snapshot hashes against reconstructed history during normal IBD. Linked issue #32377 notes this allows full nodes to 'crowdsource trust through independent snapshot verification', though it is an audit enhancement rather than a critical consensus fix or urgent security defect.
